title: Two-Person Statue · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Two-Person Statue · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and a familiar situation, such as waiting for a bus. The pair makes a still scene without speaking or touching each other. The remaining players identify the situation; with two players, the pair explains the scene afterward. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Two-Person Statue, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The remaining players identify the situation; with two players, the pair explains the scene afterward.
recall.why: The remaining players identify the situation; with two players, the pair explains the scene afterward.
